title: 修复安装版示例工程初始化
changes: 修复安装或更新后新建工作工程出现 resources\example ENOENT 的问题。
示例工程随安装包独立分发，并在打包时逐文件核对完整性。
工程复制完成后才启用目标目录；兼容旧版创建失败留下的空目录，保留已有工程。
changesEn: Fixed resources\example ENOENT when creating a working project after installation or update.
Bundled examples are distributed outside app.asar and verified file by file during packaging.
New projects become available only after copying finishes. Existing projects and folders left by older failed attempts are preserved.
